value.rationale: It fully resolves a natural extension of a named nonabelian open problem over an unbounded family (all odd primes, all cyclic center lengths >=2, all symplectic ranks), with a sharp exponent-dependent one-versus-two spectrum and a constructive automorphism orbit transitivity theorem.
